text:
Sam: New launch post draft uploaded -> https://drive.re/redwood/launch-v4. Can folks skim the benchmark headline and the CTA flow? debating 'median ~40ms' vs 'p95 <180ms' for the hero. Also note: embargo until next TH.
Tara: Looking. Quick clarifier  do those numbers include auto-batching and KV cache warm?
Sam: They include auto-batching (burst policy) and warm KV cache for the Hosted baseline. We'll surface cold-start numbers in the appendix.
Dev: I'll paste the exact bench command and a short note about the prompt mix. bench command we used: `./bench_tool --model redwood-giant --seq 512 --batch 8 --runs 120 --device h100 --auto-batch --cache warm`
Dev: Prompt mix was 60% short completions, 30% chat-like turns, 10% long-form. I'll add a CSV sample of requests and the RNG seed.
Priya: Legal: avoid absolute phrasing like "fastest". Any p95 claim needs reproducible methodology inline + hardware table and stats window. Also we need embargo language in the header.
Linh: For webinar, can we run A/B subject lines and route inbound signups into variant buckets? Need lead tags `launch-webinar-a` / `launch-webinar-b` and UTM templates.
Marcom-bot: Routing rule ready to create: incoming form -> webinar-list; split by `utm_campaign` param -> tag `launch-webinar-a` or `launch-webinar-b`; default tag `launch-webinar`. Followups: day 2 and day 8. Confirm to enable.
Sam: Confirm enable. Also map CTA to trial nurture list and add tag `launch-early-access`. Make sure the landing page includes UTM params: `utm_campaign=launch_v4` & `utm_source=blog`.
Linh: I'll prep the A/B subject lines and landing variants. Also will grab social snippets.
Priya: Conditional legal OK once appendix includes hardware table, exact commands, prompt mix, dataset sample, RNG seed, and a note on measurement variance.
Dev: Appendix updated: GPU types, kernel flags, full bench command, prompt CSV sample, RNG seed `42`, and raw logs -> https://ci.re/redwood/logs/launch-v4. Added 1-paragraph variance note.
Tara: Nice. For the hero I'd recommend median for the public blog and call out p95 in a highlighted badge for technical readers. Keeps marketing crisp and honest for platforms.
Sam: Agreed. We'll lead with median in the hero and include a p95 badge + link to appendix. Locking the doc in 10m and scheduling publish for tomorrow 10:30 PT. Embargo reminder: do not share externally until publish window.
Linh: All set on growth side. I'll push webinar landing drafts to the doc and wire the UTM rules.
Marcom-bot: Routing rule created and tags attached as requested. Followups scheduled.
Priya: Legal gives final sign-off after appendix link is live in the draft.
Dev: Link is live. All good from infra side.
Sam: Great work. Locking draft now. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
